GOT target of AppleARMPlatform, AppleARMWatchdogTimer, AppleProcessorTrace and AppleT8140CLPC. AppleARMPlatform calls ml_cpu_init_completed and then IOService::publishResource(*slot, ...); the watchdog and a kernel function call IOService::resourceMatching(*slot, 0) and waitForMatchingServiceWithToken(..., -1, 0). That is the all-CPUs-initialized resource symbol (iokit/Kernel/IOService.cpp gIOAllCPUInitializedKey; UniXNU's iPad 23F84 fixture binds the same symbol). Checked 2026-11-21.

GOT target of AppleARMWatchdogTimer and AppleProcessorTrace. Both read the pointer once and OSCompareAndSwapPtr a PAC-signed (IA, 0x2abe) callback of their own into it; the watchdog only when the -panic_notify boot argument is set (AppleARMWatchdogTimer::start). An exported pointer kexts swap a callback into is pexpert/arm/hwtrace/hwtrace.c PE_arm_debug_panic_hook (const NULL in Apple's RELEASE build, hence its read-only address; writable in the DEVELOPMENT native). Unbound, the swap would write native kernel text. Checked 2026-11-21.

GOT target of IOHIDFamily, AppleT8140CLPC and ExclaveKextClient. Each loads the 32-bit value and branches to a trace path when it is nonzero, before ordinary work (IOHIDFamily's IOHIDFamilyTrace.h kdebug macros). The exported 32-bit flag kexts test this way is bsd/kern/kdebug.c kdebug_enable. On 27 the same entry was left unbound and landed in zone_array. Checked 2026-11-21.

GOT target of IOSerialFamily. Apple's initial value is -1; IOSerialFamily loads it and uses 9600 when it is -1, else the value, as the default line speed. The exported -1-initialized serial baud int is pexpert gPESerialBaud. Checked 2026-11-21.

GOT target of IOSerialFamily. In ttyinput Apple's kernel increments 0x...e390 when ICANON is set and 0x...e398 otherwise, then 0x...e3a0 always; ttyoutput increments 0x...e3a8. bsd/kern/tty.c: ICANON ? tk_cancc++ : tk_rawcc++; tk_nin++; ttyoutput tk_nout++. So e398 is tk_rawcc (exported). Checked 2026-11-21.

GOT target of IOSerialFamily and com.apple.nke.ppp. Incremented unconditionally by Apple's ttyinput after the canonical/raw counter (see the tk_rawcc entry): bsd/kern/tty.c tk_nin (exported). Checked 2026-11-21.
